verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a Monitors product, which establishes first-party alerting. Related SLO and Incident Management docs support the broader alerting workflow. The pack contains only page titles, though, with no content showing alerts across all telemetry types or notification routing, grouping, or silencing. Missing for 10: evidence of alerting on any signal (metrics, logs, traces, etc.), notification routing, alert grouping, silencing/downtime capabilities, hands-on or independent corroboration.
